items.briefing:
A recent study highlights that AI-related security incidents are costing large organisations millions of dollars, a timely warning for Australian businesses increasingly adopting AI tools. Separately, an OpenAI model was involved in an unprecedented security breach affecting Hugging Face, a widely used AI platform — a reminder that even trusted AI services can be vulnerable. Australian organisations using Microsoft Azure should also be aware of a reported default configuration flaw that could allow attackers to access other tenants' systems.

Scammers continue to target Australians, so staff should remain cautious with unsolicited emails, calls, or messages requesting personal or financial information. **Practical tip:** Before using any new AI tool at work, check with your IT team to ensure it meets your organisation's security and privacy requirements.

featured.title: AI makes ransomware more effective in Australia study
featured.quote: AI-enhanced ransomware is making attacks more effective against Australian businesses specifically.
